_comment: Tier 1 'Measured' inputs captured from the NME console (no API exists for these). Copy to observed-data.local.json, fill in what you have, and pass with -ObservedData. Everything is optional - missing values fall back to modelled estimates. Screenshot paths resolve relative to this file; keep images under ~1.5 MB (PNG/JPG).

environment._autoScaleSavings_help: From NME: overall auto-scale savings for the period - both the $ amount and the %. Shown as 'value already realised'.
environment._law_help: From the Log Analytics workspace (Usage / Perf tables) or Azure Cost Management. lawUserInputDelayGbPerMonth is best; lawIngestionGbPerMonth alone still improves the estimate.
environment._riCoveragePercent_help: Share of session-host compute already covered by Reserved Instances / Savings Plans (from the customer's Azure portal > Reservations/Savings plans, or NME's RI Analytics view). Deflates the auto-scale / pre-stage / rolling-drain compute savings (powering off pre-paid capacity saves nothing) and the remaining commit-discount opportunity. Omit if unknown.

hostPools.name: RF-MultiSession
hostPools.notes: From NME Auto-scale History, last 30 days. Per-pool riCoveragePercent overrides the environment figure for this pool if set.
